summary: Battery recycling engineers design and run the plants that discharge, shred and chemically refine spent lithium-ion packs into black mass and battery-grade metals, at firms like Redwood Materials, Umicore, Ascend Elements, Cirba Solutions and Hydrovolt, under rules such as the EU Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542. AI helps most with process troubleshooting, mass-balance and recovery-efficiency reporting, regulatory and battery-passport documentation, and safety planning for thermal-runaway and hazmat risks.

prompts.title: Incoming pack triage plan
prompts.task: Sort a mixed inbound shipment of end-of-life batteries by chemistry, condition and hazard before pre-processing.
prompts.prompt: You are a senior battery recycling process engineer. We received [SHIPMENT DESCRIPTION: e.g. 40 EV packs, mixed NMC/LFP, some flood-damaged] with this manifest and inspection notes: [PASTE DATA]. Our pre-processing line uses [DISCHARGE METHOD: brine / resistive / electronic] and [DISASSEMBLY: manual / semi-automated]. Produce a triage plan as a table: lot ID, likely chemistry and how to confirm it, condition class (intact / damaged / suspected defective), hazard flags (swelling, leakage, elevated temperature, high residual SOC), required handling step, and quarantine yes/no. Then list information gaps I must close before anyone opens a pack. Do not guess chemistry where the label is missing; mark it unknown.
prompts.caution: Damaged or defective lithium cells are a thermal-runaway and toxic-gas hazard; final handling decisions belong to qualified staff following your site's procedures and 49 CFR 173.185 / ADR rules for transport.

prompts.title: Black mass yield troubleshooting
prompts.task: Diagnose a drop in black mass yield or purity from the shredding and separation line.
prompts.prompt: Act as a process engineer for a mechanical battery recycling line ([LINE: inert-atmosphere shredder, magnetic separation, eddy current, sieving, etc.]). Over [TIME PERIOD], black mass yield fell from [X]% to [Y]% and Cu/Al contamination rose to [VALUE]. Process data and recent changes: [PASTE: feed mix, screen sizes, shredder RPM, drying temps, maintenance log]. Give a ranked list of root-cause hypotheses, each with the evidence for and against it from the data, the cheapest test to confirm or rule it out, and the likely fix. End with what extra measurements (e.g. PSD, ICP-OES on fractions) would most reduce uncertainty.
prompts.caution: Hypotheses are starting points; confirm with lab assays before changing setpoints.

prompts.title: Recycling efficiency calculation
prompts.task: Calculate recycling efficiency and material recovery rates for EU Battery Regulation reporting.
prompts.prompt: You are a compliance-minded battery recycling engineer preparing figures under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Annex XII, and the Commission's delegated act on calculation methodology. Inputs for [REPORTING PERIOD]: input battery mass by chemistry [DATA], output fractions with masses and assays [DATA], and destinations of each fraction [DATA]. Calculate (1) overall recycling efficiency for lithium-based batteries versus the 65% (2025) and 70% (2030) targets, and (2) material recovery rates for Li, Co, Ni and Cu versus the 2027 and 2031 targets. Show every step in a table, state which fractions you counted as recycled and why, and flag any assumption where the methodology is ambiguous or still being finalized.
prompts.caution: Verify against the current text of the regulation and delegated acts; official figures need sign-off by the responsible person and any required auditor.

prompts.title: Thermal event hazard review
prompts.task: Run a structured hazard review of a storage or processing area for battery fires.
prompts.prompt: Act as a process safety engineer facilitating a HAZOP-style review for [AREA: inbound battery storage / discharge bay / shredder]. Site details: [LAYOUT, QUANTITIES, BATTERY TYPES, DETECTION AND SUPPRESSION, SEPARATION DISTANCES, LOCAL CODES]. Produce a table of deviations (e.g. damaged cell enters storage, discharge overheats, shredder ingests charged cell), causes, consequences including off-gas (HF, CO, flammable electrolyte vapor), existing safeguards, gaps, and recommended actions with priority. Reference relevant guidance such as NFPA 855, NFPA 13, FM Global data sheets and local fire code where applicable, and note where guidance for recycling facilities specifically is thin or evolving.
prompts.caution: This supports, not replaces, a formal PHA led by qualified safety professionals and coordination with the local fire authority.

prompts.title: Hydromet leach optimization plan
prompts.task: Design an experiment plan to improve metal leaching recovery while controlling reagent cost.
prompts.prompt: You are a hydrometallurgist on a lithium-ion recycling team. Our leach step uses [ACID, CONCENTRATION, REDUCTANT, TEMP, S/L RATIO, TIME] on black mass of [CHEMISTRY MIX]. Current leaching efficiencies: Li [X]%, Ni [X]%, Co [X]%, Mn [X]%. Constraints: [REAGENT BUDGET, EQUIPMENT LIMITS, EFFLUENT LIMITS]. Propose a design-of-experiments plan (factors, levels, design type, run count) to raise recovery, explain the chemistry behind each factor, predict trade-offs such as impurity co-leaching (Al, Cu, Fe) and downstream solvent extraction impact, and list the measurements and KPIs to track. Note which conclusions depend on our specific feed and must be verified at bench scale.
prompts.caution: Follow lab safety protocols for acids and peroxide; scale-up requires pilot validation.

prompts.title: Battery passport data mapping
prompts.task: Map plant data to battery passport and recycled-content documentation requirements.
prompts.prompt: Act as a battery data and compliance specialist. Our plant produces [OUTPUTS: e.g. nickel sulfate, lithium carbonate, cobalt sulfate] sold to [CUSTOMERS: cathode makers / cell makers]. Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, battery passports apply from February 2027 and recycled-content declarations follow. Using the Battery Pass consortium content guidance and GBA Battery Passport work as references, list which data our customers will likely ask us for (recycled content share, pre-/post-consumer origin, carbon footprint, chain of custody). Map each to the source system we have [LIST: MES, LIMS, ERP, weighbridge], identify gaps, and draft a data-sharing checklist. Flag items still awaiting delegated or implementing acts.
prompts.caution: Requirements and timelines are still being finalized; check the latest Commission acts before committing to formats.

prompts.title: Community briefing on new plant
prompts.task: Prepare plain-language answers for residents concerned about a proposed recycling facility.
prompts.prompt: You are helping a battery recycling engineer prepare for a public meeting about our proposed facility in [LOCATION]. Process: [PROCESS SUMMARY], capacity [TONNES/YEAR], permits sought [PERMITS]. Residents' concerns so far: [LIST: fires, air emissions, truck traffic, water use, jobs]. Write an 8th-grade-reading-level FAQ of 10 to 12 questions with honest, specific answers drawn only from the facts I provided, including what we do to prevent and respond to fires and what emissions monitoring is planned. Where I haven't given you facts, write [NEED DATA] rather than reassuring. End with three questions we should expect that are hard to answer and how to address them candidly.
prompts.caution: Do not overstate safety; have permit, EHS and legal staff review before publication.

prompts.title: Recycling chemistry upskill path
prompts.task: Build a learning plan for an engineer moving into battery recycling from another field.
prompts.prompt: I am a [CURRENT ROLE, e.g. chemical engineer in mining / mechanical engineer in automotive] moving into battery recycling engineering. I know [STRENGTHS] and am weak in [GAPS]. Build a 12-week learning plan covering: Li-ion cell chemistries and how they change recycling (NMC, LFP, NCA, emerging sodium-ion and solid-state), pyrometallurgy vs hydrometallurgy vs direct recycling (e.g. DOE ReCell Center work), black mass characterization, hazmat and transport rules, and EU/US policy drivers. For each week give goals, two or three real resources (textbooks, review papers, ReCell or Argonne EverBatt materials, standards), a hands-on exercise, and a self-check question. Flag areas where industry practice is changing fast.
prompts.caution: Verify that cited resources exist and are current before relying on them.
